summary.headline: Dermatology group captures $1.18M in annual savings across 12 spend categories
summary.narrative: Across two sourcing waves, Treya Partners delivered $1,179,965 of annualized savings for Adult & Pediatric Dermatology (APDerm). Six categories – including Medical Supplies, Courier Services and Janitorial – are already under executed contracts representing $861,880 in locked-in savings, while another $318,085 is moving through final signature or rollout. Savings were achieved through a blend of competitive RFPs, GPO leverage and incumbent negotiations that preserved service continuity while lowering cost by up to 27% in key areas.
